methods.name: buffered_bytes
methods.summary: Returns the total number of buffered bytes in the decoder

methods.name: clear_all_ranges
methods.summary: Clear any staged byte ranges currently buffered for future decode work.

methods.name: into_builder
methods.summary: Decompose this decoder back into a [`ParquetPushDecoderBuilder`] for the row groups that have *not* yet been decoded.

methods.name: is_at_row_group_boundary
methods.summary: True iff the decoder is at a row-group boundary, where [`Self::into_builder`] can reconfigure the scan.

methods.name: peek_next_row_group
methods.summary: Returns the row-group index that the next call to [`Self::try_next_reader`] will yield a reader for, after applying any internal skipping (row selection emptiness, exhausted budget, finished state).

methods.name: push_range
methods.signature: fn push_range(&mut self, range: Range<u64>, data: Bytes) -> Result<(), ParquetError>
methods.summary: Push data into the decoder for processing

methods.name: push_ranges
methods.signature: fn push_ranges(&mut self, ranges: Vec<Range<u64>>, data: Vec<Bytes>) -> Result<(), ParquetError>
methods.summary: Push data into the decoder for processing

methods.name: row_groups_remaining
methods.summary: Number of row groups left to decode after the one currently in flight. Useful as a "should I bother reconfiguring the scan?" signal.

methods.name: try_decode
methods.summary: Attempt to decode the next batch of data, or return what data is needed

methods.name: try_next_reader
methods.summary: Return a [`ParquetRecordBatchReader`] that reads the next set of rows, or  return what data is needed to produce it.
